{{Quote|PL-1s? I’ve never heard of them.|Wedge Antilles|<ref name="bacta">''[[X-Wing: The Bacta War]]''</ref>}}
'''PL-1''' was the designation for [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]].<ref name="bacta" />

Prior to the start of the [[Bacta War]], all of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron's]] [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] and other equipment were sold off as surplus, reportedly because they were missing parts like PL-1's. [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] thought this was the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] covert way of helping their cause of liberating the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]] from former [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]] [[Ysanne Isard]].<ref name="bacta" />
